toolbar.description: Accessible name of the capsule in the title bar that holds the version picker and the Run button.

hideSidebar.description: Title bar button that hides the file sidebar.

showSidebar.description: Title bar button that shows the file sidebar again.

edited.description: Shown after the fiddle name in the title bar when the fiddle has unsaved changes.

windowTitleEdited.description: The OS window title when the fiddle has unsaved changes. {{name}} is the fiddle name.

settings.description: Title bar button that opens the settings page.

files.description: Accessible name of the file list in the sidebar.

processMain.description: Sidebar section head and editor label for files that run in Electron's main process.

processPreload.description: Sidebar section head and editor label for preload scripts.

processRenderer.description: Sidebar section head and editor label for files that run in the renderer (web page).

errorCount_one.description: Pill on a sidebar file row and in an editor pane header: how many runtime errors the file has. Singular.

errorCount_other.description: Pill on a sidebar file row and in an editor pane header: how many runtime errors the file has. Plural.

warningCount_one.description: Pill on a sidebar file row, tab badge and editor pane header: how many editor warnings the file has, when it has no errors. Singular.

warningCount_other.description: Pill on a sidebar file row, tab badge and editor pane header: how many editor warnings the file has, when it has no errors. Plural.

resizePanes.description: Accessible name of the divider between the two editor panes in split view.

notificationsButton_one.description: Accessible name of the status bar bell button when there is one notification the user hasn't seen in the list. Singular.

notificationsButton_other.description: Accessible name of the status bar bell button when there are notifications the user hasn't seen in the list. Plural.

noNotifications.description: Shown in the notification list when no notification has appeared in this window.

clearNotifications.description: Button in the notification list header that removes every past notification from the list.

unsaved.description: Spoken by screen readers for the dot on a file with unsaved changes.

hiddenFile.description: Spoken by screen readers for a file whose editor is hidden.

filterFiles.description: Placeholder of the search field that filters the sidebar's file list.

addFile.description: Sidebar button and file menu item that adds a new file to the fiddle.

addFileTitle.description: Title of the dialog that asks for a new file's name.

fileName.description: Label of the file name field in the new-file and rename dialogs.

fileNameHint.description: Explains which file extensions a fiddle file may have. Shown in the new-file and rename dialogs.

create.description: Button that creates the new file.

cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog without doing anything.

rename.description: File menu item that renames a file. Opens a dialog.

renameTitle.description: Title of the rename dialog. {{name}} is the current file name.

delete.description: File menu item that removes a file from the fiddle. Asks first.

deleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms removing a file. {{name}} is the file name.

deleteMessage.message: The file and its contents are removed from this fiddle.
deleteMessage.description: Body of the dialog that confirms removing a file.

closeTab.description: File menu item that closes the file's editor tab. The file stays in the fiddle and in the file list.

openTab.description: File menu item that opens the file in an editor tab.

fileActions.description: Accessible name of the menu of actions for one file.

fileChangeFailed.description: Title of the notification shown when adding, renaming, removing, showing or hiding a file fails.

openFiles.description: Accessible name of the row of editor tabs.

splitEditor.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the tab row button that opens a second editor pane.

closeSplit.description: Tooltip and accessible name of the tab row button while the editor is split; it closes the second pane.

popOut.description: Editor pane header button that opens the file in its own window.

maximize.description: Editor pane header button that closes the split and keeps only this pane.

closePane.description: Editor pane header button that closes this editor pane.

editorFor.description: Accessible name of the code editor for one file. {{name}} is the file name.

resizeSidebar.description: Accessible name of the divider between the sidebar and the editor.

resizeConsole.description: Accessible name of the divider between the editor and the console.

emptyTitle.description: Title shown in the sheet when every editor pane is closed.

emptyText.message: Every tab is closed. Open a file from the sidebar, or reset the layout to bring the tabs back.
emptyText.description: Text shown in the sheet when every editor tab is closed.

resetLayout.description: Button that restores the default editor layout and opens every file in a tab.

dropOpenHere.description: Shown on the first half of the editor while an editor tab is dragged over it: dropping the tab there shows its file in the main editor pane.

dropOpenBeside.description: Shown on the second half of the editor while an editor tab is dragged over it: dropping the tab there opens its file in a second pane beside the main one.

lensHint.description: Hint under a runtime error shown in the editor. {{process}} is 'main process', 'preload' or 'renderer'; the rest is the location.

lensProcessMain.description: Inserted into the error hint: 'Thrown in the main process at …'. Lower case.

lensProcessPreload.description: Inserted into the error hint: 'Thrown in the preload at …'. Lower case.

lensProcessRenderer.description: Inserted into the error hint: 'Thrown in the renderer at …'. Lower case.

lensErrorTitle.description: Title of a runtime error shown in the editor when the error has no type name such as TypeError.

cursorPosition.description: Status bar: the cursor's line and column in the current editor.

languageJavascript.description: Status bar: the current file's language. Product name; keep as is.

languageHtml.description: Status bar: the current file's language. Keep as is.

languageCss.description: Status bar: the current file's language. Keep as is.

languageJson.description: Status bar: the current file's language. Keep as is.

dropToOpen.description: Shown over the editor while a gist link, an electron-fiddle link or a fiddle folder is dragged over the window.

dropToOpenHint.message: A gist link, an Electron Fiddle link or a fiddle folder replaces this fiddle.
dropToOpenHint.description: Second line shown while something is dragged over the window, explaining what dropping it does.

status.description: Accessible name of the status bar at the bottom of the window.

notifications.description: Accessible name of the region where notifications appear.

dismiss.description: Accessible name of the button that closes a notification.

stubRun.description: Placeholder Run button until the run feature lands.

stubPublish.description: Placeholder Publish button until the gists feature lands.

stubConsole.description: Placeholder console title until the run feature lands.

stubReady.description: Placeholder status bar text until the run feature lands.

stubPackages.description: Placeholder sidebar section head until the packages feature lands.

stubAddPackage.description: Placeholder package field until the packages feature lands.

stubVersion.description: Placeholder version picker until the versions feature lands.

stubSettingsTitle.description: Placeholder settings page title until the settings feature lands.

stubCloseSettings.description: Placeholder button that closes the settings page.

tabFocusMode.description: Status bar indicator shown while tab-focus mode is on: the Tab key moves keyboard focus out of the editor instead of inserting a tab. Tab is the key's name.

regionErrorTitle.description: Title shown in place of a part of the window (the sidebar, the editor area) that failed to display because of an internal error.

regionErrorBody.message: This part of the window stopped working. Reload the window to try again.
regionErrorBody.description: Text under the title shown in place of a part of the window that failed to display.

regionErrorReload.description: Button under the error shown in place of a failed part of the window. Reloads the window.
